issue.title: Panache entity leads to NPE when no database config is present

labels.name: upstream/closed

body:
Just tried various versions of Quarkus and here is what I see:

With Quarkus `1.3.4.Final`, when `quarkus.datasource.db-kind` is missing, then you get the following build-time exception:

```
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:1.3.4.Final:build (default) on project todo-app: Failed to build quarkus application: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
[ERROR]         [error]: Build step io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.HibernateOrmProcessor#build threw an exception: io.quarkus.deployment.configuration.ConfigurationError: Hibernate extension cannot guess the dialect as no database kind is specified by 'quarkus.datasource.db-kind'
```

When moving to Quarkus `1.7.5.Final`, there is no build time error and the application fails at runtime with:

```
2020-11-17 08:31:23,575 ERROR [io.qua.ver.htt.run.QuarkusErrorHandler] (executor-thread-1) HTTP Request to /api failed, error id: b3f8b602-558a-4a67-a501-7c87f4b682af-1: org.jboss.resteasy.spi.UnhandledException: javax.persistence.PersistenceException: No EntityManager found. Do you have any JPA entities defined?
```

Finally with Quarkus `1.9.2.Final` (and `1.10.0.CR1`) the runtime exceptions: 

```
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException
        at io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.panache.common.runtime.CommonPanacheQueryImpl.createBaseQuery(CommonPanacheQueryImpl.java:322)

```

With Quarkus 1.9.x+ this warning does show up at build time:

```
[WARNING] [io.quarkus.agroal.deployment.AgroalProcessor] The Agroal dependency is present but no JDBC datasources have been defined.
[WARNING] [io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.HibernateOrmProcessor] Model classes are defined for the default persistence unit but no default datasource found: the default EntityManagerFactory will not be created.
```

@gsmet I would like to know if this change from build time to runtime error was intentional or not before proceeding any further.

Basically I think this boils down to:

Is there any scenario where `[WARNING] [io.quarkus.agroal.deployment.AgroalProcessor]  The Agroal dependency is present but no JDBC datasources have been defined.`  should indeed be a warning and not a build time error?

> Basically I think this boils down to:
> 
> Is there any scenario where `[WARNING] [io.quarkus.agroal.deployment.AgroalProcessor] The Agroal dependency is present but no JDBC datasources have been defined.` should indeed be a warning and not a build time error?

-1 to making it a build time error. Having additional dependencies on classpath should not be an error, we can just ignore it.

Also think of the workflow in dev-mode: one needs to first add the dependency, then configure it. It shouldn't explode at the first step.

Right, that makes sense.

I think we can take care of this and #13338 if we have proper error message when Panache tries to execute a query when there is no EntityManager.

I'll check out that avenue.

@geoand +1
I recall at least one other NPE with Panache in this area - I hope you could tidy up its reference checking, have a broad look around its expectations of having an actual EM reference?
